indications_and_usage: Warfarin sodium tablets are indicated for prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis.
contraindications: Warfarin sodium is contraindicated in pregnancy.
warnings: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding.

indications_and_usage: Warfarin sodium tablets are indicated for prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism (updated 2023).
contraindications: Warfarin sodium is contraindicated in pregnancy, except in women with mechanical heart valves.
warnings: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding. Regular monitoring of INR is required.
boxed_warning: Bleeding risk. Regularly monitor INR in all treated patients.

indications_and_usage: Generic warfarin sodium tablets, indicated for prophylaxis and treatment of thrombosis.
warnings: Can cause major or fatal bleeding.
